note: The single Kymbo topic bank. Replaces the earlier three-bank split (fire-your-middleman, educational-technical, craft-and-team) after Impeccable's distill pass on 2026-08-11 found the taxonomy was ~3x the concepts needed to ship a batch of 12. Three pillars, twenty-five topics. Every topic that survives here is one-of-a-kind — variations on the same argument were collapsed into their strongest single form. Verified numerical proof still lives in stack.json.verifiedStats and is cited by source.

pillars.The Money: What's leaking, and where. Commission, cancellation, guest data, upsells. The argument for going direct, sharpened by concrete arithmetic.
pillars.The Craft: The discipline behind the build. Performance budgets, plugin caps, hosting positions, launch discipline, the standards Kymbo publishes and holds itself to.
pillars.The Team: The shape of the shop. Who does the work, how they onboard, how they hand off, the nearshore reality, the human contract with the client.

howToUse: Pull to the batch mix per the feed rules in system/render.mjs. Assign one primary trigger at pull time (one of: authority, reciprocity, loss-aversion, curiosity, commitment). Mark usedIn once shipped. When the pool drops below 15 unused, refresh from the archive banks (retired) or from new Notion research.
